websiteContent: Home Piano Tips CONTACT FORM ​ALL INCLUSIVE PIANO LESSONS Zen Piano Studio offers live and online high-quality virtual piano lessons for beginner, intermediate and advanced students. Our studio prides itself on being a warm, open, and fun environment for children, teenagers, adults, and senior citizens to learn and advance the skills needed for a fulfilling piano journey. Lessons are thoughtfully and professionally tailored to the age, background, needs, goals, and learning style of each student. A special emphasis is placed on mindfulness and relaxation which nurtures positive growth, awareness, self-confidence, and the ability to play with ease. All-inclusive piano lessons create well-rounded pianists by including all aspects of musical training that will enable the student to explore various musical pathways. The focus of lessons include different styles of playing, the development of strong technique, ear-training, sight-reading, composition, improvisation, songwriting, memorization, theory, relaxation and performance skills.​ ​STUDENTS PERFORMing ​PIANO FOR RELAXATION Learn pieces that utilize movement and relaxation techniques at all levels. Students with this focus build a solid personalized repertoire of calming music to feel accomplished and refreshed.​ ​PIANO FOR AUDITIONS AND PERFORMANCES Advanced and intensive level coaching is available for students who are preparing for college entrance auditions, competitions, or other performances. All the essentials including appropriate repertoire, stage presence, visualization, note accuracy, memorization strategies and skills, dynamics, choreography, and musicality are polished for professional- level performances.​ ​PIANO FOR PRODUCERS AND SONGWRITERS Creative artists are given the tools needed to intelligently navigate the keys by learning how to translate their musical ideas into sound. This approach includes tricks and shortcuts to develop various sounds, patterns, chord progressions, and embellishments to enhance any musical project or song. Artists may use what they've learned to develop their songs for pop, rock, jazz, blues, dance, and music from a wide array of genres.​ ​​ABOUT JODI RUSSELL, Ed.D., M.M., B.M., NCTM Pianist and Educator, Jodi Russell, is a Nationally Certified Teacher of Music with over 15 years of experience performing and teaching the piano. Her students range from preschool to college level as well as working adults and senior citizens with a wide variety of musical goals and learning styles. Jodi's expertise in technique and musicality as well as her knack for diversity enables her students to develop all-inclusive musicianship while exploring various musical styles. Zen Piano Studio include award winning students who have gone on to major in music, teach music, and produce music of their own. ​THE TOOLS YOU NEED TO SUCCEED ​Being a great musician beings with the will and desire to succeed. If you are committed to following your dreams, you are already on the way!Y
